label: Bloom filter / Per-Page Bloom Filter (Index Service, Plasma)
type: a memory-management enhancement for the Plasma storage engine, configurable via the Index REST settings API.
relates_to_competency_question: Does the Plasma storage engine use a Bloom filter for memory efficiency, and can that be toggled via REST?
evidence: If Bloom filters are enabled (which is the default), when a lookup occurs, and the correct Plasma page is located, the Bloom filter indicates either that the item is not on the page, or that it may be on the page.
By indicating that the item is not on disk, the filter prevents unnecessary on-disk searches.
